fields.label: Enable Monthly Inventory
fields.description: Daily scheduler creates one check per month, including catch-up after downtime. Configure item groups and excluded references before enabling.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Count only enabled stock warehouses under AMF Warehouse / Production, excluding OLD BATCH.

fields.label: Warehouse Scope
fields.description: Only enabled stock warehouses within this Production group are included. OLD BATCH is excluded.

fields.label: Assigned To
fields.description: Setup selects alexandre.trachsel@amf.ch when that enabled System User exists. Otherwise choose an assignee before saving or enabling inventory checks.

fields.label: References per Check
fields.description: Exactly ten distinct references are randomly selected from eligible item groups, after exclusions.

fields.label: Due Day of Month
fields.description: 1 to 28. A late catch-up check keeps its original due date.

fields.label: Item Groups
fields.description: All groups are enabled by default except Product. Uncheck Enabled to exclude a group and all its subgroups. A disabled parent takes precedence over enabled children.

fields.label: Excluded References
fields.description: References in this table are always excluded from future monthly selections, even when their item group is enabled.

fields.label: Legacy Reference List
fields.description: Retained for historical compatibility. Eligibility is defined by item groups and exclusions.
